approach: ColdWarAssault.exe 1.99 statically recompiled to C with pcrecomp (lift32 + win32hle), 64-bit, Direct3D 8 on Vulkan or OpenGL
help: testing on other Linux machines and GPUs
notes: Operation Flashpoint: Cold War Crisis as re-released by Bohemia Interactive. Menus, single missions and campaign missions run; about 60 fps on a 2017 desktop CPU at the longest view distance. Direct3D 8 (on Vulkan or OpenGL), DirectInput 8, DirectSound 3D and Winsock are host code. No game file is in the repository: users bring their own copy.
